feature: Editing a title never starts playback, and every part can be clicked
summary: Typing a title's words and pressing Command Return no longer plays anything: the words stay picked, the title sits still with every part on screen, and one click with the Select tool picks the subtitle, the accent or any other part.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: editing-a-title-never-plays-walk.

try.do: Open a recording, add a track above V1, right-click the new track and choose Add Title Page > Stacked Stagger.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Type a headline and press Command Return. Nothing plays; the headline stays picked.
Click the small line under the headline once.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Double click that line, type new words, press Command Return.
Click the small square accent once.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Escape to step up to the whole title, then set Energy to Punchy. It does not play.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Escape again, click the second line, then press Replay in the Part section.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: After Command Return, is everything on the title there to click straight away?
Does one click on a part feel like picking a layer of a graphic in Premiere's Program monitor?
Once you have pressed Escape to hold the whole title, is it right that the next click keeps the whole title (so you can drag it), with a second Escape or a double click to get back to a part?
When the Part section's Replay plays one part, does holding every other part still read as replaying just that part?
Is it right that a right click on a title you are not inside opens the whole title's menu (Animate In and the rest), and on a part only once you are working inside the title?
rough: No mock covers what happens after typing in a title or what a click on a title picks, the title walkthrough page included.

After Escape the whole title stays whole under a click so it can be dragged as one; reaching a part again takes a second Escape (letting go) or a double click. That is my reading of the task's 'Escape steps up to the whole title', not something the user said.
Replay Title is on the title's clip menu on the timeline and in the Clip menu; the canvas right-click on a title has never carried it and still does not.
A part's Replay holds every other part where it rests and plays the part from its first key to its last; a moving background keeps its rest frame during that replay too.

With a layer picked, a double click on a Library title tile inserts nothing (the shelf jumps between the two clicks). Older than this change but easier to hit now that typed words stay picked: filed as double-clicking-a-library-title-tile-inserts-it.
